title: The Three-Fractal method develops hypotheses with complementary AI systems

statements.text: Hypotheses are developed by three roles, a generative Sentinel, a skeptical Librarian and a sovereign Architect, and each claim is scored by a Luster Score from 0 to 1 over source verification, internal consistency, falsifiability, mechanism coherence and independent testability.

sources.quote: Central to this framework is the Luster Score, a quantitative 0.0–1.0 metric that measures claim integrity across five operational criteria
